description: This file defines the MaxMindGeoIP2 class which provides methods for retrieving geolocation and IP-related data using MaxMind's database. It includes constants for capabilities, methods for fetching geo info, handling cookies, and managing database readers.

classes.name: MaxMindGeoIP2
classes.description: A class providing static methods to access MaxMind GeoIP data, manage database readers, and handle geolocation cookies.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns available capabilities based on configured MaxMind databases.

methods.name: getGeoInfo
methods.description: Retrieves geolocation information for an IP address, optionally using cookies for persistence.

methods.name: getMmdbPaths
methods.description: Returns the path(s) to the MaxMind database files.

methods.name: hasCustomConfig
methods.description: Checks if a custom database path is configured.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Returns the MaxMind account ID from configuration.

methods.name: getLicenseKey
methods.description: Returns the MaxMind license key from configuration.

methods.name: getCookieArray
methods.description: Returns the array of cookie keys for geolocation data.

methods.name: packCookie
methods.description: Serializes geolocation data into a cookie string.

methods.name: unpackCookie
methods.description: Deserializes a cookie string into geolocation data array.

methods.name: getReaders
methods.description: Generator that yields MaxMind database Reader instances.
